zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，把基因组模型推进到按细胞类型解读 DNA；Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API，正式加入决策模型赛道。今晚还有 OpenAI 网络安全直播，细节待会后核实。

important.title: 重要消息
items: DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，按特定细胞类型预测 DNA 及其变异对基因表达等分子读出的影响；非商业研究即日起可通过 AlphaGenome API 使用，官方明确仅供研究、尚未用于临床诊断。
Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API，一次前向可处理最多约 1000 个封闭式问题，定价为每百万输入 token 10 美分、输出免费，与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Luna 决策模型同价。
今晚 18:00（北京时间，对应 10:00 PT）OpenAI 举办 Cyber at the Frontier 网络安全直播，介绍把自身防守经验做成客户可用工具的最新发布；细节待会后核实。

sections.title: AlphaGenome 2
sections.body: 于 11/11 晚（北京时间约 23:03）由 @GoogleDeepMind 宣布。官方称相对前代，能识别出近两倍会改变细胞中基因表达的变异；在 TenK10K（28 种原代免疫细胞）上，因果变异召回为 30% 对 16%，方向性基因效应为 43% 对 23%。训练数据含逾 1.07 亿条单细胞图谱、覆盖 68 种组织。商业研究为私人预览。

sections.title: Gemini Decisions API
sections.body: 输入覆盖文本、图像、音视频和 PDF，返回校准概率。开发者文档已上线；Simon Willison 同日记录其定价，并称目前三家决策模型里它是唯一原生覆盖音视频与 PDF 的。

sections.title: OpenAI 与 Codex
sections.body: 产品侧 @thsottiaux 在周四前写道 “Thursday is feeling codexy”，并提到 “banked reset”；今早稳定版 rust-v0.167.2 已发布，默认在 Google Cloud Vertex AI 上增量推送工具更新。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: DeepSeek Harness 实验线前进到 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2（Git Worktree 审阅、具名多层 SubAgent / 按会话开启的 AgentTeam）；codex 新稳定版 0.167.2。Hermes Agent 仍为昨日的 v0.23.1，OpenClaw 仍为 v2026.11.3；Cursor changelog 自 11/6 无新条目。Grok Bot 官方 changelog 页今日被 Cloudflare 拦截，未能核对 Latest 条文；Homebrew 与更新接口现报 Mac 客户端 1.0.1，较昨日所见的 0.79.4 有版本号跃迁，官方尚未公布 1.0.1 功能说明。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: @karpathy、@AndrewYNg、@AnthropicAI 与 @Meta 近 24–48 小时无高信号原创；关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X，近几日也无官方新模型发版。Anthropic 11/10 的 IPO 路演未作为技术条目。OpenAI 直播结果需今晚后再核。

en.lead: Biggest product news today: DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, taking genome models to cell-type-specific DNA reading, and Google shipped the Gemini Decisions API, entering the decision-model race. OpenAI’s cybersecurity livestream is still ahead this evening; details after it airs.

important.title: Headlines
items: DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, which predicts how a DNA sequence and its variants affect molecular readouts such as gene expression in a chosen cell type; it is available now for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, and is officially research-only, not validated for clinical or diagnostic use.

Google launched the Gemini Decisions API: one forward pass can score up to about 1,000 closed questions, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with free output, matching OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna decision model.
Tonight at 18:00 Asia/Shanghai (10:00 PT) OpenAI hosts the Cyber at the Frontier livestream on turning its own defense experience into tools customers can use; details after it airs.

sections.title: AlphaGenome 2
sections.body: Announced late on Nov 11 (~23:03 Asia/Shanghai) by @GoogleDeepMind. Officially it identifies nearly twice as many variants that change expression in cells versus the prior model; on TenK10K (28 primary immune cell types) causal-variant recall is 30% vs 16%, and directional gene effects 43% vs 23%. Training includes more than 107 million single-cell profiles across 68 tissues. Commercial research is in private preview.

sections.title: Gemini Decisions API
sections.body: It accepts text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, and returns calibrated probabilities. Developer docs are live. Simon Willison recorded the same-day pricing and noted it is so far the only one of the three decision models with native audio, video, and PDF support.

sections.title: OpenAI and Codex
sections.body: OpenAI product lead @thsottiaux wrote ahead of Thursday that “Thursday is feeling codexy,” and mentioned a “banked reset.” Stable rust-v0.167.2 shipped this morning, sending tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI.

sections.title: Product column
sections.body: DeepSeek Harness’s experimental line moved to dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2 (Git Worktree review, named multi-level SubAgents / session-scoped AgentTeam); Codex has a new stable 0.167.2. Hermes Agent remains yesterday’s v0.23.1, OpenClaw remains v2026.11.3, and Cursor’s changelog has had no new entry since Nov 6. The official Grok Bot changelog page was blocked by Cloudflare today, so Latest notes could not be checked; Homebrew and the update API now report the Mac client at 1.0.1, a version jump from yesterday’s observed 0.79.4, with no official 1.0.1 feature notes.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: @karpathy, @AndrewYNg, @AnthropicAI, and @Meta had no high-signal original posts in about 24–48 hours; the follow list still has no first-party DeepSeek account, and DeepSeek has not officially shipped a new model in recent days. Anthropic’s Nov 10 IPO roadshow is not treated as a tech item. OpenAI livestream results need a later check.

summary.en: Announces AlphaGenome 2: a model that predicts how DNA variants affect disease-relevant molecular activity in specific cell types; trained on 100M+ single-cell profiles across 68 tissues, available via API for non-commercial research.

title.zh: AlphaGenome 2：按细胞类型解读 DNA，更好地理解疾病
title.en: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease

summary.zh: 11/11 由 Adam Gayoso、Natasha Latysheva、Pushmeet Kohli 与 Žiga Avsec 发布。AlphaGenome 2 是条件模型：在约 100 万碱基的 DNA 窗口之外，还输入目标细胞类型或状态，一次预测一种条件。官方称相对前代能识别近两倍会改变细胞中基因表达的变异；在 TenK10K 上因果变异召回 30% 对 16%、方向性基因效应 43% 对 23%。训练含逾 1.07 亿条单细胞图谱、覆盖 68 种组织，并可在少量新细胞数据上不做再训练即适配。非商业研究经 AlphaGenome API 开放，商业为私人预览；仅供研究，未用于临床诊断。
summary.en: Published Nov 11 by Adam Gayoso, Natasha Latysheva, Pushmeet Kohli, and Žiga Avsec. AlphaGenome 2 is a conditional model: besides a ~1-million-letter DNA window, it takes a target cell type or state and predicts one condition at a time. Officially it identifies nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the prior model; on TenK10K, causal-variant recall is 30% vs 16% and directional gene effects 43% vs 23%. Training includes more than 107 million single-cell profiles across 68 tissues, and it can adapt to a small new single-cell snapshot without retraining. Available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, with commercial research in private preview; research-only, not for clinical diagnosis.

title.zh: Gemini Decisions API：一次前向完成封闭式决策，定价 $0.10/百万输入
title.en: Gemini Decisions API: closed-ended decisions in one pass, $0.10 per million input tokens

summary.zh: 11/11 上线。官方开发者文档指向 Gemini Decisions API（模型 gemini-decision-1）。据 Simon Willison 同日记录与随后的文档转述：一次前向最多约 1000 个封闭式问题（是否 / 选择 / 量表），输入可为文本、图像、音视频和 PDF，返回校准概率；定价每百万输入 token 10 美分、输出免费，与 GPT-6 Luna 决策模型同价（Jev 仍更低，约 4.2 美分）。本机未抓到独立的 blog.google 新闻稿，条目以官方文档与工程博客为准。
summary.en: Shipped Nov 11. Official developer docs describe the Gemini Decisions API (model gemini-decision-1). Per Simon Willison’s same-day notes and later documentation write-ups: one forward pass can score up to about 1,000 closed questions (yes/no, choice, or rubric) over text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, returning calibrated probabilities, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with free output—matching GPT-6 Luna, while Jev remains cheaper at about 4.2 cents. No standalone blog.google launch post was retrieved here; the item follows official docs and the engineering write-up.

title.zh: 动手看 Gemini Decisions API：与 Jev、GPT-6 Luna 同赛道
title.en: Gemini Decisions API: Google joins Jev and OpenAI in decision models

summary.zh: 11/11 22:03 GMT（约北京时间 11/12 06:03）发布。记录 Google 以 Gemini Decision 1 加入决策模型类别，题型与 Jev 几乎相同（是否、选择、量表），甚至沿用 Jev 的 “Noul” 称呼；定价与 GPT-6 Luna 决策模型相同。Jev 只支持文本/JSON，OpenAI 支持文本和图像，Gemini Decision 1 则覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF。文中附有用视频做是否题的实测概率输出。
summary.en: Posted 22:03 GMT on Nov 11 (~06:03 Nov 12 Asia/Shanghai). Notes that Google joins the decision-model category with Gemini Decision 1, almost identically to Jev (yes/no, choice, rubric) and even reuses Jev’s term “Noul.” Pricing matches the GPT-6 Luna decision model. Jev is text/JSON only, OpenAI handles text and images, and Gemini Decision 1 covers text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. Includes a live yes/no probability dump on a video file.

alphaxivTop3.title: Embodied First Exam
alphaxivTop3.authors: Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Changhe Chen, Pingyue Zhang, Chi Gui et al.

summary.zh: （仍约热榜第 1，昨日已报）面向「用编码 agent 控制机器人」的评测：允许 agent 自选直接控制、写代码控制等路径，补上现有基准偏视动策略学习、难以检验编码 agent 在物理约束下可靠性的缺口。
summary.en: (Still ~#1 on alphaXiv’s trending list; carried from yesterday.) A unified, agent-native robotics exam: coding agents may choose their own control path (direct control, code-to-control, etc.), filling a gap left by benchmarks built around visuomotor policy learning.

alphaxivTop3.title: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
alphaxivTop3.authors: Amani Kiruga, Zhiyi Li, Ruojin Cai, Hansen Lillemark, Xiaoshan Wu, Ayush Tewari, Yilun Du

summary.zh: （热榜约第 2，新上榜）用一个生成式框架同时做 RGB 视频生成与深度、相机位姿等几何预测：通过对不同模态和时间分配不同噪声水平，把视觉生成与几何预测写成条件补全。论文称在只给首尾两帧时，测试时搜索可降低平移方向误差。
summary.en: (~#2 on the trending list, new today.) A unified generative model for RGB video and geometric signals such as depth and camera pose, treating generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion by assigning different noise levels across modalities and time. The authors report that test-time search cuts translation-direction error when only the first and last RGB frames are given.

caption.en: Trending card for UGG (source: alphaXiv; mirrored in-repo)

alphaxivTop3.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hao Kang, Weili Xu, Ziyang Li, Zheng Du, Hanchen Li, Tian Xia, Song Bian, Tushar Krishna, Huizi Mao, Ion Stoica et al.

summary.zh: （Agent 优先；热榜约第 3，新上榜）面向 agent 推理负载的自适应 serving：把计算角色（prefill/decode）与 KV cache 管理解耦，运行时按 agent 工作负载和上下文复用调整。论文称在 Claude Code 对照中，相近系统因角色切换丢失 55.5% 的理想 KV 命中，而该方法只丢失 0.3%，节点角色切换约 0.7 秒。
summary.en: (Agent pick; ~#3 on the trending list, new today.) An agent-adaptive serving stack that decouples prefill/decode compute roles from KV-cache management and adapts both at runtime to agent workloads and context reuse. In the paper’s Claude Code comparison, a related system loses 55.5% of ideal KV hits across in-place role switches, versus 0.3% here, with a role switch in about 0.7 seconds.

summary.zh: 新实验标签 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2（GitHub published_at 2026-11-11T11:33:06Z，约北京时间 11/11 19:33，昨日早报之后）。新功能：Git Worktree 可按分支/提交/文件类型审阅，并直接处理 GitHub 评审、同步已审阅进度和更新分支；SubAgent 支持具名与多层协作，AgentTeam 可按会话开启并共用成员与任务面板；桌面端可在设置中切换正式版与开发版更新渠道。网页搜索默认改用 DeepSeek Search API。近几日未见 DeepSeek 官方新模型发版。
summary.en: New experimental tag dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2 (GitHub published_at 2026-11-11T11:33:06Z / ~19:33 Nov 11 Asia/Shanghai, after yesterday’s brief). New: Git Worktree review by branch, commit, and file type, with GitHub reviews, synced reviewed-file progress, and branch updates in DSH; named multi-level SubAgents, and AgentTeam enabled per session with a shared member and task panel; desktop settings can switch stable vs development update channels. Web search now defaults to the DeepSeek Search API. No official DeepSeek model release in recent days.

summary.zh: 新稳定版 rust-v0.167.2 / 0.167.2（GitHub published_at 2026-11-11T22:44:46Z，约北京时间 11/12 06:44）。发行说明写明：在 Google Cloud Vertex AI 上默认改为增量发送工具更新；若要退出，在 config.toml 的 [features] 下设置 incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false。预发布线同期还有 0.170.0-alpha.1 与 0.169.0-alpha.11.1 等，说明多为版本号。
summary.en: New stable rust-v0.167.2 / 0.167.2 (GitHub published_at 2026-11-11T22:44:46Z / ~06:44 Nov 12 Asia/Shanghai). Release notes: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI; to opt out, set incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false under [features] in config.toml. The prerelease line also moved to 0.170.0-alpha.1 and 0.169.0-alpha.11.1, mostly tag-only notes.

summary.zh: 今日无新官方 changelog。产品侧最新仍是昨夜已报的 Claude Whiteboards / Sheets（付费计划 beta）与 Claude Data（GA），以及 interactive connectors。模型侧仍以 11/9 的 Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 为最新（API $8/$40，可选 fast mode $16/$80）。今日 @claudeai 分享艺术家 Mariko Mori 用 Claude 写代码完成装置动画，属合作展示而非功能发版。
summary.en: No new official changelog today. The latest product ship remains last night’s Claude Whiteboards / Sheets (paid-plan beta) and Claude Data (GA), plus interactive connectors. The latest models remain Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 from Nov 9 (API $8/$40, optional fast mode $16/$80). Today’s @claudeai post on Mariko Mori using Claude to code an installation is a collaboration showcase, not a feature release.

summary.zh: 自 11/6 起 changelog 仍无更新条目。页面置顶仍为 2026-11-06 Voice Chat with Agents——与 agent 实时语音通话（Agents Window / IDE / Web / iOS），由 Grok Voice 驱动。另有 11/5 Build Live Apps（Cloud Agent 脚手架 Web 应用并部署分享）。
summary.en: Still no new changelog entry since Nov 6. The page still leads with Voice Chat with Agents (2026-11-06): a realtime voice call with an agent in the Agents Window, IDE, web, and iOS, powered by Grok Voice. The prior entry is 11/5 Build Live Apps (cloud agents scaffold a web app and deploy a shareable link).

summary.zh: 官方 changelog 页今日从本机抓取被 Cloudflare 拦截，未能核对页面 Latest 条文；第三方摘录仍显示过期的 v0.78.1，与昨日现场读到的 v0.79.3 不一致，故不引用其功能列表。Homebrew cask 与 Cursor 更新接口现报 Mac 客户端 1.0.1（下载路径已到 grokbot/stable/.../1.0.1/），较昨日所见的 0.79.4 出现版本号跃迁；官方尚未公布 1.0.1 功能说明。changelog 常滞后客户端，故只对照写出两端，不把版本跃迁写成已确认的功能发版。
summary.en: The official changelog page was Cloudflare-blocked from this machine today, so Latest notes could not be checked; a third-party extract still showed stale v0.78.1, which disagrees with yesterday’s live read of v0.79.3, and is not used for feature lists. Homebrew cask and the Cursor update API now report the Mac client at 1.0.1 (download path grokbot/stable/.../1.0.1/), a version jump from yesterday’s observed 0.79.4; no official 1.0.1 feature notes. Changelog often lags the client—report both ends, and do not treat the jump as a confirmed feature release.

changeSummary.zh: 本期「模型」板块改为按得分÷单任务成本展示性价比前 10，并附官方得分前 10 对照。
changeSummary.en: This edition now ranks models by score ÷ cost per task (top 10 by value), and still shows the official top 10 by score.

summary.zh: 按得分÷单任务成本，性价比最高的是极低成本配置：GPT-5.6 Luna Low（16.0% / $0.03，约 533 分/$）和 Haiku 5.5 Low（30.9% / $0.08）。在分数更可用的区间，Haiku 5.5 High（42.3% / $0.32）和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 系列（约 45–48 分、成本低于 $1）更均衡。官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Carbon High 以 60.4%、$9.22 领跑；Fable 5.2 Max 虽有 60.0%，但单任务 $32.79，性价比在全部 89 个配置中垫底。
summary.en: Ranked by score ÷ cost per task, the highest-value configs are the cheapest ones: GPT-5.6 Luna Low (16.0% / $0.03, about 533 pts/$) and Haiku 5.5 Low (30.9% / $0.08). In a more usable score range, Haiku 5.5 High (42.3% / $0.32) and the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 series (about 45–48 points, under $1) are more balanced. The official scoreboard is still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High at 60.4% and $9.22; Fable 5.2 Max also hits 60.0%, but at $32.79 per task it has the lowest value among all 89 configurations.
